# Paris Personal Tours

> > Private guided tours of Paris, French Riviera, Loire Valley, and France with accredited driver-guides specializing in customized cultural, literary, and historical experiences.

Paris Personal Tours offers bespoke guided experiences throughout France, from classic Paris monuments and museums to themed literary tours following Alexandre Dumas and F. Scott Fitzgerald, plus coastal explorations of the French Riviera including Cannes, Nice, and Antibes.

## Key Topics

- Private driver-guide services
- Customized tours
- French Riviera
- Paris museums and monuments
- Literary tours (Dumas, Fitzgerald)
- Versailles
- Loire Valley castles
- Orsay Museum
- Catacombs
- Man in the Iron Mask
- Accredited guides
- Cannes and Lérins Islands
- French cultural heritage
- Museum passes
- Private minivan tours
